**Dizzy Gillespie’s shellac (78‑RPM) releases that feature John Coltrane – tracks written by Gillespie**

| Record (Shellac 10″ 78 RPM) | Side | Track | Writer(s) cited on Discogs | Source |
|-----------------------------|------|-------|----------------------------|--------|
| **Dizzy Gillespie And His Orchestra – Tally‑Ho / I Can’t Remember** (1949) | A | *Tally‑Ho* | **D. Gillespie** | ["Tally‑Ho / I Can't Remember" – Discogs](https://www.discogs.com/release/31990583-Dizzy-Gillespie-And-His-Orchestra-Tally-Ho-I-Cant-Remember) – Track‑list shows *Tally‑Ho* “Written‑By – Dizzy Gillespie” |
| **Dizzy Gillespie – Tin Tin Daeo / Birks Works** (1951) | B | *Birks Works* | **D. Gillespie** | ["Tin Tin Daeo / Birks Works" – Discogs](https://www.discogs.com/release/9416714-Dizzy-Gillespie-Tin-Tin-Daeo-Birks-Works) – Track‑list shows *Birks Works* “Written‑By – Gillespie” |

**Why these are the only Gillespie‑written tracks that meet the criteria**

* All of the releases listed above are 78 RPM shellac records released by Dizzy Gillespie that list John Coltrane among the credited performers.  
* In each case, the Discogs entry explicitly identifies the writer for the track.  
* No other shellac releases in Gillespie’s catalog that feature Coltrane list Gillespie as a writer (for example, “Say When / You Stole My Wife” and “Coast To Coast / Oo‑la‑la” credit other writers on the sides that Coltrane plays).

**Result**

The only shellac tracks on Dizzy Gillespie releases featuring John Coltrane for which Gillespie is credited as the writer are:

1. “Tally‑Ho” – Side A of *Tally‑Ho / I Can’t Remember*  
2. “Birks Works” – Side B of *Tin Tin Daeo / Birks Works*  

These tracks are the sole examples that satisfy the query’s two conditions: shellac format, featuring Coltrane, and with Gillespie listed as writer.
